ordered_exclusive_control_branches.reason: These three historical scientific slots need current-build comparison evidence. The old raw and COMPLETE records remain historical; no source/mode/fixture grid expansion is introduced.

control_dependency_rules: A current H control replaces only matching current-context dependencies/references; it does not alter the old H receipt.
The current I vectorized FD control depends on its newly COMPLETE current I vectorized base, and passes the unchanged original FD verifier.
H/I/K cross-lane comparison evidence is soft; it does not block otherwise independent native jobs. Same-lane FD parents remain hard.
The binary-change branch already contains H base, so never add a fourth path-only H control.

Every additional control is explicit in the manifest, has one distinct create-only output directory and at most one attempted execution. Failed/interrupted/timed-out attempts remain terminal; failed raw is retained.
Historical evidence-integrity verification and current-build matching admission are separate statuses. Valid old raw must not be relabeled as current-build evidence.
A source or owner pin change remains BLOCKED. A valid different binary hash does not grant a new source/physics or tolerance scope.

original_build_admission_to_preserve.native: Use the original G known-binary branch or its valid-build provenance branch, including owner_commit/build_exit/input_sha256/owner_source.tar and binary identity; do not invent a NATIVE_BUILD_RECEIPT.json filename requirement.
original_build_admission_to_preserve.bridge: Use original H bridge build receipt, compiled source pins, binary_sha256, VigilODE commit, Diffsol version and successful build checks.
original_build_admission_to_preserve.runtime_source: Pinned unchanged H/I/F/G bytes, exact published K source closure and actual H→I→K ancestry; no dirty manifest self-authority.

performance_comparability: Current-build control admission is not a performance result. Compare measured jobs only after actual source, build, controls, environment, affinity and timers are recorded; old host timings are not silently promoted to a matched current-environment speedup.
implementation_status: Scope decision only; scheduler/binder focused implementation and independent review still pending.
